environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on ECS Fargate in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no internet gateway route). Service is exposed exclusively through an AWS PrivateLink interface VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). The VPC endpoint has an endpoint policy restricting access to principals within the organization (aws:PrincipalOrgID condition). The service's security group only allows inbound from the VPC endpoint ENI security group (sg-0fedcba987654321) on port 3000. Additionally, the VPC endpoint itself has a resource policy requiring requests originate from specific VPC IDs and the endpoint connection requires manual acceptance by the service owner. There is no public DNS resolution for the service - only private hosted zone entries resolve within consuming VPCs.

config.network: isolated private subnet, no IGW, no NAT
